description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans serialization support, specifically testing Newtonsoft.Json integration. It includes test classes that verify deep copying, round-trip serialization, and handling of native JSON types, with focus on the 'NewtonsoftJsonCodec' features within Orleans.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecTests
classes.description: Unit test class for Orleans' Newtonsoft.Json serialization support, focusing on encoding, decoding, and deep copying of custom and native JSON types.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecCopierTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying deep copying capabilities of the Newtonsoft.Json codec in Orleans, including handling of native JSON types.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serializers in the test builder to include Newtonsoft.Json serializer with specific type support predicate.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates an instance of MyNewtonsoftJsonClass for testing purposes.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonDeepCopyTyped
methods.description: Tests deep copying of strongly typed MyNewtonsoftJsonClass instances.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonDeepCopyUntyped
methods.description: Tests deep copying via untyped serializer of MyNewtonsoftJsonClass instances.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Verifies round-trip serialization and deserialization through the codec.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonRoundTripThroughUntypedSerializer
methods.description: Verifies round-trip serialization and deserialization through the untyped serializer.

methods.name: CanSerializeNativeJsonTypes
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of native Newtonsoft.Json types like JArray and JObject.

methods.name: CreateCopier
methods.description: Creates a deep copier for MyNewtonsoftJsonClass instances.

methods.name: CanCopyNativeJsonTypes
methods.description: Tests deep copying of native Newtonsoft.Json JSON types.
